name: Mong Bán
text: Mong Bán is a variant form of the name Mongfhind (2), the wife of Eochaid Mugmedón in the Niall Noigiallach story cycle.

okr.objective: Documents Mong Bán as recorded in MacKillop 2008 for the Public Celtic Encyclopedia.
key_results: Mong Bán is a variant of Mongfhind (2).
Mongfhind (2) is the wife of Eochaid Mugmedón.
The name belongs to the cycle around Niall Noigiallach.
